title: Four telescopes, one field in Sagittarius
description: How 116 hours of exposure from four telescopes reveal the Lagoon, the Trifid, and faint hydrogen across the field between them.
author: Dr. Aous Abdo
imageAlt: The Lagoon Nebula at center and the red-and-blue Trifid below it, amid diffuse red emission and dark lanes in Sagittarius
